title: Und das bei diesen Preisen
desc: Two minutes of agreeing with a stranger
setting: Platform two at twenty past seven, a board reading plus four, and a man you have never spoken to.

options.es: Und am Montag war es auch schon.
options.en: And on Monday it happened too.
options.feedback: Agree and add one. That is the whole form and it lasts about two minutes.

options.es: Es sind ja nur vier Minuten.
options.feedback: Correct, and it is the one thing that is not allowed. He was not asking to be right.
Not wrong, and it leaves him holding the conversation on his own.
The strongest thing you can say here and it is one syllable.

options.es: Dafür fährt fast immer alles pünktlich.
options.en: On the other hand almost everything runs on time.
options.feedback: True, and it is the second correction. He will turn away and be perfectly polite about it.
The other fixed line. Interchangeable, and it keeps the two minutes going.
A fact, small, and it is how a platform acquaintance starts. You will nod at him for years.

options.es: Ich bin erst seit drei Jahren hier.
options.en: I have only been here three years.
options.feedback: An answer to a question he did not ask. He asked about the train.
He is making conversation on a platform. That reads as suspicion.
One word, dry, and it ends the two minutes cleanly. He will laugh through his nose.

options.es: Endlich. Das war wirklich zu viel.
options.en: Finally. That really was too much.
options.feedback: Still going at minute four. The form is over when the train arrives.
Warm and a bit large for a man you complained with. A nod does it.
